architecture_scope: Repair the shared admission receipt ordering edge without weakening readiness. Magmaw is only the canary.

first_broken_edge.cause: All ten members and every non-receipt readiness predicate passed, but readiness evaluated receipt_size=0 against receipt_expected_size=10 before admission could commit.

next_action: Implement one minimal shared-runtime correction so readiness validates the candidate admission receipt for the same cohort instead of an empty pre-commit receipt. Preserve every readiness predicate, add compiled counterexamples, and stop before build or live execution.

allowed: inspect the DVC-bound admission receipt and exact source path
change only admission receipt construction, validation ordering, or a small pure helper required by that ordering
add focused compiled tests for ten exact members, missing member, duplicate member, and failed pre-commit validation
split touched C++ by concern to keep every file below 1000 physical lines
one independent read-only review after implementation
forbidden: relaxing receipt size, roster, lease, role, spec, difficulty, native group, entrance placement, or alive-state predicates
manufacturing or post-hoc patching an admission receipt
pet AI, hunter-pet identity, class, encounter, movement, MMAP, route coordinate, or Z changes
configure, build, worldserver, authserver, database, or DVC mutation during implementation
claiming live closure from unit tests

acceptance: readiness evaluates a candidate receipt built from the same provisioned cohort and exact ten unique members
a ten-member candidate can pass only when every existing readiness predicate passes
a missing or duplicate member fails before commit with a typed receipt reason
a failed candidate never overwrites the last committed admission receipt or enables bot actions
all aggregate and per-member diagnostic fields remain available before rollback
native pathing continues to follow terrain; no bot-authored Z correction exists
focused compiled tests pass and every touched C/C++ file remains below 1000 physical lines
independent review confirms no predicate relaxation or unrelated gameplay change
